description:
Wait for an order's status to leave `inProgress`, reading it every 15 seconds for up to
about 45. Returns the order as `get_order` does, as soon as its status changes or once
the wait is over; call again while it is still `inProgress`. Under heavy load it may
return after a single read. Reports progress when the client asks for it.

id.description: Order id, source Bitcoin txid, or source EVM tx hash

name: wait_for_order
